Render a UMG through DiagrammeR (Graphviz)

Source: R/dot.R
umg_render_dot.Rd

Renders the DOT export of a UMG to an interactive HTML widget using DiagrammeR's Graphviz engine, suitable for notebooks, Shiny, and rmarkdown HTML output.

Usage

umg_render_dot(model, ...)

Arguments

model

An object of class umg.

...

Passed to umg_to_dot().

Value

A grViz/htmlwidget object.

Examples

umg_render_dot(umg_irt("2PL"))
